name: Advanced Distribution System Analysis
description: Introduction to distribution systems - typical components and topology, differences and similarity with transmission system, operational role in larger power grid; electric loads - load allocation across a feeder and related metrics, static ZIP load modeling, three-phase inductor machine load modeling; unbalanced distribution line segment modeling - series impedance of lines, shunt admittance of lines, effect of ground, ABCD modeling of line segment; voltage regulation - 3-phase voltage regulators modeling, feeder voltage regulation; 3-phase transformers modeling, load tap changers; Unabalcned 3-phase distribution system power flow - forward-backward sweep and other advanced power flow methods; introduction of software tools to simulate and solve distribution system; special topics relevant to modern distribution systems such as renewable integration, microgrids, protection and cyber-security, planning aspects of distribution systems, basic reliability metrics, introduction and impact of distributed energy resources (DERs) as solar rooftop PV, electric vehicles etc.
